content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends the use of GLP-1 receptor agonists for reducing cardiovascular risk in patients who have type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease (CKD). This recommendation applies specifically to individuals with an estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) of 20 mL/min/1.73 m² or higher. The use of GLP-1 receptor agonists is particularly suggested for patients who are unable to tolerate SGLT2 inhibitors.
